Trellis 2 reads a single image, rebuilds its shape and surface, and delivers a download-ready 3D model — usually in well under a minute.

A product image, a character drawing, a toy on your desk — the AI needs just one clear image to reconstruct the full 3D shape.
Textures Included
The mesh arrives with color and surface detail already applied, so it looks right the moment you open it in a viewer or engine.
Zero Setup, Zero Cost
Everything runs in the browser tab you already have open. No installs, no registration wall, no charge to download your result.
Your Images Stay Private
Uploads go straight to the AI for processing and are deleted right after. Nothing you submit is stored or shared.

True 3D Reconstruction

Adjustable Face Count

Fast Turnaround

Standard GLB Export

GLB opens everywhere: Blender, Unity, Unreal, Three.js, iOS Quick Look, and most slicers for 3D printing.

Built-In AI Image Editor

A second tab lets you edit images with text prompts — restyle, relight, or clean up an image before turning it into 3D.

Use Hunyuan 3D in 3 Simple Steps

Hunyuan 3D turns your flat images into untextured 3D models. Here's how:

1
Upload Your Image

Drag and drop or click to select any image — product photos, character art, objects, or sketches.

2
Hunyuan 3D Builds Your 3D Model

The AI analyzes your image and constructs a 3D mesh with geometry and surface detail, without textures.

3
Download & Use

Download the GLB file and use it in game engines, 3D printers, AR/VR apps, or e-commerce product pages.

The Technology Behind Hunyuan 3D

A closer look at what makes Hunyuan 3D generate high-quality 3D results from a single image.

AI Image-to-3D Engine

Hunyuan 3D reconstructs 3D geometry from a single 2D image.

Untextured Mesh Output

Outputs contain geometry without textures. Download the GLB for viewing or further editing in a 3D tool.

Generation Time

One model generates at a time, with room for 3 waiting tasks. Generation time depends on the queue and service startup.

GLB Format Export

Hunyuan 3D exports in GLB — the universal standard supported by all major 3D platforms, game engines, and AR/VR frameworks.

3 Free Generations a Day

Use Hunyuan 3D up to 3 times a day per network address. The allowance resets at 00:00 UTC.

Desktop, Tablet & Mobile

Fully responsive interface that works on any device. Turn product photos into 3D assets right on your phone.
